verdict: Paid ads have been paused since Aug 6; leads are being recovered.
narrative: Meta advertising went dark on August 6 and has not run since — all 29 leads and $741.52 in spend this period were generated before that date. In the meantime, your Google Business Profile continued driving activity, recording 179 actions including 59 calls, and organic Instagram reach picked up noticeably in the final days of the period without any paid support behind it. Ads are being brought back online, and the intake pipeline is being repaired so that incoming leads move through properly. Next period you should see paid lead volume resume alongside a functioning intake workflow.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all before August 6 when paid ads paused
calls generated through your Google Business Profile this period
cost per lead while ads were running — a healthy baseline to return to

watch_item.issue: 28 leads arrived this period but none moved into the intake pipeline — appointments and opportunities show zero, pointing to a gap in how new contacts are being processed.
watch_item.fix: CRM intake is being repaired and SMS automation goes live by August 31 to ensure leads flow through automatically from the moment they arrive.
